Signed squared-norm intervals determine resolution. A square-root interval is the monotone transformation after intersecting its signed interval with the nonnegative domain. Cosines are never clipped. Direction cosines are omitted when the required mean is unresolved. The on-policy component is compared with the existing mean norm if resolved, otherwise its stored upper interval endpoint; comparison_kind and comparison_value appear in CSV and JSON.
